title: The August Tell

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: You win your fantasy league in August — and it's not by drafting the big names.

lines.speaker: george
lines.text: Here's the whole secret: fantasy points come from touches. The ball. More touches, more points. That's it.

viz.label: THE ONLY MATH THAT MATTERS
viz.sub: the guy who gets the ball wins

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: Okay, so how do I find the guy who's about to get a ton of touches?

lines.speaker: george
lines.text: You look for an empty job. When a starting running back leaves a team, someone inherits all of those touches.

viz.label: A STARTER LEAVES →
viz.sub: all those touches are up for grabs

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: So who's got an empty job this year?

lines.speaker: george
lines.text: Bhayshul Tuten. The Jaguars let Travis Etienne walk — that's eleven hundred yards, gone. Tuten's their number one now, and he ran the fastest forty of any back in his draft class.

lines.speaker: jessica
lines.text: And everyone's still sleeping on him?

lines.speaker: george
lines.text: Because he was a backup last year, so he's cheap. That's the game — draft the job before the price catches up.

caption: The simplest way to win your fantasy league: don't chase the stars. Find the empty job. Here's the one August tell the pros watch — and the name it's flashing on right now.
